title: Buttersmooth Vanilla
description: A lightweight modpack that drastically improves performance while enhancing the classic Vanilla experience with subtle quality-of-life features
body:
**Buttersmooth Vanilla** is a _lightweight_, _performance-optimized_ modpack designed for those who want to experience Minecraft at its best — smooth, stable, and enhanced with smart quality-of-life features.

Perfect for Vanilla purists who want more comfort and control without sacrificing the original feel. Powered by top-tier performance mods like **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **Starlight**, the game runs buttery-smooth even on lower-end systems. At the same time, small but impactful mods like **Inventory Profiles Next**, **Xaero’s World Map**, and **Controlling** bring noticeable gameplay improvements without breaking immersion.

Key Features:
- **Massive** FPS boost from modern optimization mods
- Handy QOL upgrades
- Fully compatible with Vanilla multiplayer servers
- Great for both solo and multiplayer play
